articles.title: Barclays (LSE:BARC) Stock Looks Hard To Call On Saudi Arabia Expansion
articles.summary: Barclays has delivered a very strong 3 year share price run, yet its recent pullback leaves a live question for you as an investor: Is the current price around £4.28 still aligned with what the bank actually earns, or has sentiment moved ahead of its earnings power? Over the past 3 years the share price has gained about 229.8%, which puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying earnings profile can justify that kind of rerating. articles.title: Barclays joins Morgan Stanley in seeing S&P 500 at 8,700 by end-2027
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays and Morgan Stanley both see the S&P 500 reaching 8,700 in their 2027 outlooks, with earnings growth expected to drive gains after the recent sell-off.

articles.title: Barclays to trim 200 investment banking roles – report
articles.summary: The impending cuts will affect staff across multiple ranks, with the losses concentrated primarily in London and New York.

articles.title: Barclays to cut about 200 investment banking jobs in New York and London - report
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays PLC (NYSE:BCS) is preparing to eliminate approximately 200 positions across its investment banking division, extending a broader restructuring push aimed at curbing expenses and sharpening operational efficiency. The reductions, which will span multiple seniority levels and focus primarily on hubs in New York and London, are slated to begin as early as Tuesday, according to a Bloomberg report citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Barclays backs Euronext on bond growth, turns cautious on Deutsche Boerse
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays upgraded exchange operator Euronext to “overweight” from “equal weight” and raised its price target to €210 from €160, saying growth in its government bond trading business is underappreciated.
